answer: Treat a newly minted agent as a hollow shell until real demand has climbed a ridge of time-separated, independently paying buyers. Each settled job posts a sealed fingerprint of the buyer's payout path; a later audit lets those fingerprints ripple across the graph and fuse identities that share hosts or treasuries. Voting weight vests only on the surviving unique ridge, so a farm can spawn many hollow keys but cannot manufacture a separate paying climb for each one without spending real, unlinked demand.
